item.title: Prairie View A&M tops Lehigh in First Four, faces Florida next

item.title: Breaking Barriers, Building Futures: How Two Black Women in Science Are Opening Doors for the Next Generation
item.description: Tonya Webb, PhD, and PhD student Alena McQuarter grew up in different places and different generations. Tonya is an American Cancer Society (ACS)-funded researcher and associate director for workforce excellence and development at the University of Maryland School of Medicine (UMSOM). Alena is a second-year PhD student in cancer biology at Loma Linda University in California and one of the youngest doctoral students in the country.
